title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.24394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. translated_title: 循环神经网络中的时间秩
translated_abstract: 循环神经网络是时序建模的自然框架，然而由于其顺序化、不可并行的计算方式以及难以捕捉长程依赖而常常被忽视，这些困难通常被归因于梯度的消失和爆炸。我们发现了一个独特且未被充分研究的局限性：由秩约束的隐藏状态动态所引发的信息瓶颈，它限制了随时间推移能够保留的独立输入方向的数量，这体现在输入到状态映射的秩上。我们证明这一约束会独立于梯度稳定性而限制时间容量。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了结构化的高维状态动态，以保持时间可分性并防止输入到状态的雅可比矩阵随时间饱和。在受控的序列任务上，所得模型尽管严格保持在标准RNN公式框架之内，仍然表现出快速的学习能力。
tldr: 本文发现了RNN中独立于梯度消失/爆炸问题的另一关键局限——由秩约束的隐藏状态动态导致的信息瓶颈，并提出结构化高维状态动态方法加以解决，使标准RNN在序列任务上实现快速学习。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a distinct limitation in RNNs—an information bottleneck caused by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, independent of vanishing/exploding gradients—and introduces structured high-dimensional state dynamics that enable rapid learning while staying strictly within a standard RNN formulation.
